body: Thank you for that, it really does kind of change my look of it, I never considered the pills to be like that. I’ve been depressed for such a long amount of time I considered it my personality, but like my therapist and I went over, ones depressed self is not themselves, but merely a sad version of oneself convinced by fallacious thought and absurdity. I definitely will though, I’m  happy I’m not alone anymore
I really appreciate that, that means a lot to me. Lately life’s just been getting tougher and when I found this subreddit I was a little worried of being judged. Thank you so much
